welcome.title: Welcome to frolik 👋
welcome.body: frolik helps you get out of the house and meet new people through real-life Outings. Let's start with how to plan an Outing — it takes about a minute.

planOuting.title: Plan an Outing
planOuting.body: Every Outing needs two things: an activity, and at least one Daily Match — someone you haven't met yet. You get fresh matches every 24 hours, and you can invite friends too.

pickActivity.title: Pick an activity
pickActivity.body: Browse activities by category and tap Select. Once you've added a Daily Match, a Create Outing button appears. Invites go out and a group chat is created for the Outing.

filterOrCreate.title: Filter or create
filterOrCreate.body: Filter by cost, time, rating or group size, or show only completed, featured or community creations. Tap the blue + beside the categories to make a custom activity anyone in your city can use.

stats.title: Your stats
stats.body: ❄️ is your flake rating out of 5. Higher is better: 5.0 means you've never bailed on an Outing, and it drops each time you leave one or don't mark it completed. 🎈 counts the Outings you've completed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Edit your profile and set your status here. Set it to Ready to show up in other people's Daily Matches. You can replay this tour from here any time.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.body: Outing invites, friend requests and updates land here. Accept an invite to join an Outing — you can have up to 5 pending Outings at a time.

finishing.title: Finishing an Outing
finishing.body: After an Outing, open it from your Profile to upload photos and mark it complete with a rating. Once it's complete, you can add the people you went with as friends. Leaving an Outing you've joined counts as a flake.

social.title: Social
social.body: See your friends' completed Outings and like their photos.

chats.title: Chats
chats.body: Every Outing gets its own group chat. Tap + to start a chat with friends.

allSet.title: You're all set! 🎈
allSet.body: Replay this tour any time from Settings — the ⚙️ on your Profile.
